records.description: ALLETE, Inc. is a Duluth, Minnesota-based utility holding company whose businesses include Minnesota Power, Superior Water, Light and Power, ALLETE Clean Energy, BNI Energy, New Energy Equity and other energy infrastructure interests. Its regulated utility footprint is concentrated in Minnesota and Wisconsin, with clean-energy activities across North America. The take-private announced in May 2024 closed on December 15, 2025, and ALLETE survived as a privately held company under Alloy Parent LLC. CPP Investments owns 40% indirectly and Global Infrastructure Partners-managed vehicles own the remaining 60% indirectly, comprising GIP Fund V and the GIP-managed Tower Bridge vehicle. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, not as a separate owner. Regulatory filings in 2026 describe a pending internal reorganization around Minnesota Power, not a completed ownership transfer. No later owner exit or signed platform sale was identified through August 23, 2026.

The 71,522-acre lease supported a pre-construction concept of up to 2.4 GW but no generation facilities were constructed. Bluepoint Winds Holdings, LLC owns the leaseholder and is itself owned 50:50 by Ocean Winds through OW North America LLC and Global Infrastructure Partners through Seaway Energy Holdings, L.P. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, while Mubadala's undisclosed participation remains within the GIP block. On April 27, 2026, the project parties signed a settlement that suspended lease duties and provides for cancellation after specified investment verification and reimbursement steps. Founded as an independent platform in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, Clearway currently reports approximately 13.6 GW of gross capacity across 27 states. Global Infrastructure Partners acquired the predecessor NRG renewables platform in 2018 through GIP III entities. On September 12, 2022, TotalEnergies closed its purchase of 50% of Clearway from GIP, leaving GIP III and TotalEnergies as equal current owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent after the 2024 manager acquisition and Evergreen Infrastructure Fund has no Clearway ownership period.
